programme.title: Kau Untukku
programme.desc: Umairah yang sudah bertunang tetapi masih diminati oleh Fuad rakan sekerjanya. Sebaik Umairah kematian tunangnya, Fuad memulakan langkah untuk memikat Umairah. Lakonan Dira Abu Zahar, Remy Ishak dan Johan

programme.title: Kami Histeria
programme.desc: Kisah komedi seram mengenai sekumpulan pemuzik indie wanita yang menggunakan 'khidmat' langsuir sebagai suara latar untuk lagu-lagu mereka. Lakonan Diana Danielle, Nad Zainal, Mila Jirin, Nur Fazura dan Af

programme.title: Hikayat Merong Mahawangsa
programme.desc: Angkatan Rom meminta pertolongan Merong Mahawangsa mengiringi Putera Rom ke Langkasuka (dikatakan terletak di utara Malaysia) untuk berkahwin dengan seorang Puteri China yang cantik dari Dinasti Han.

programme.title: My Spy
programme.desc: Ikuti gandingan lucu AJ dan Salleh dalam aksi mereka dalam menyelesaikan kes penyeledupan lukisan yang amat berharga. Lakonan AC Mizal & Harun Salim Bachik.

programme.title: Laila Majnun
programme.desc: Qais dan Laila saling jatuh cinta semasa kecil, tetapi apabila mereka dewasa ayah Laila menghalang mereka untuk bersama.

programme.title: Selendang Delima
programme.desc: Filem yang mengisahkan tentang Tengku Bangsegara yang pergi ke Gunung Ledang untuk belajar ilmu bela diri. Bila kembali, kerajaannya sudah hancur.

programme.title: Dear Nathan Thank You Salma
programme.desc: Nathan dan Salma memasuki dunia aktivis sosial. Salma memilih untuk mengekspresi dirinya di laman digital manakala Nathan memilih untuk turun ke jalanan.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Kekasih Elektrik
programme.desc: Amri, seorang novelis dikunjungi oleh seorang gadis misteri yang muncul secara tiba-tiba di kedainya. Namun, hanya dia sahaja yang boleh melihat gadis tersebut yang juga kehilangan memori. Mereka bersama-sama mencari klu siapakah gadis tersebut.

programme.title: The Tuk Tuk of the Fifth Kind
programme.desc: A Tuk Tuk driver strongly believes that he is able to communicate with an alien from another star. The alien promises to bring him to their Utopia planet if he completes a mission.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah dan Alia rakannya telah pergi ke tapak pembinaan terbengkalai untuk mencari bahan untuk saluran YouTube nya namun tanpa di duga dia telah merakam satu pembunuhan.

programme.title: Yang Sudi Tinggal
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah Emily, kini seorang pendidik dan bagaimana Astro mengubah masa depannya.

programme.title: Marabahaya
programme.desc: Chon dipersalahkan bila Shah Dani menggunakannya untuk menghantar barang pada pelanggan Dotty. Bila berlaku kesilapan, Chon diugut Dotty agar memulangkan wang yang hilang sementara idolanya diculik.

programme.title: Yang Berani Bermimpi
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah Hael, dari pentas AF kepada nama besar industri muzik yang bersinar menerusi Astro.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Batu 120
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki tersedar dari pengsan dan mendapati dirinya berada di Kampung Batu 120. Dia berkahwin dengan anak ketua kampung namun layanan penduduk kampung mulai dingin apabila isterinya disahkan hamil.

programme.title: Yang Sanggup Berjuang
programme.desc: Karamjit 'The Flying Sikh' Singh berkongsi erti sebenar berbakti kepada negara, sempena ulang tahun ke-30 Astro ini buat para atlet dan veteran yang telah mencurahkan bakti kepada Malaysia.

programme.title: Terbaik Dari Langit
programme.desc: Berg yang percaya dia pernah melihat UFO bertahun dulu, mengembara bersama rakan-rakannya merentasi Malaysia untuk membuat filem mengenainya. Tanpa sedari perjalanan itu lebih dari apa yang kelihatan.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Cinta Elevator
programme.desc: Apabila 2 insan berlainan darjat dan profesion bertemu di dalam sebuah lif, pelbagai persepsi timbul di fikiran mereka, sehinggalah mereka berdua ditakdirkan terperangkap di dalam lif...

programme.title: Autumn In Wales
programme.desc: Aira kecewa apabila mendapat tahu tunangnya, Darwish mempunyai kekasih baru bernama Marissa. Dia cuba memenangi hati Darwish, namun ketika mencuba perasaannya berubah.

programme.title: Cinta Kura-Kura
programme.desc: Seekor kura-kura yang boleh bercakap cuba membantu seorang gadis untuk mendapatkan calon kekasih yang sesuai buatnya. Lakonan Tizz Zaqyah & Zizan Razak.

programme.title: Kami Histeria
programme.desc: Kisah komedi seram mengenai sekumpulan pemuzik indie wanita yang menggunakan 'khidmat' langsuir sebagai suara latar untuk lagu-lagu mereka. Lakonan Diana Danielle, Nad Zainal, Mila Jirin, Nur Fazura dan Af

programme.title: Ribbit
programme.desc: Seekor katak yang mengalami krisis identiti sedang mencari siapa dirinya yang sebenar dan dia percaya dirinya telah disumpah oleh satu kuasa jahat. Adakah dia akan menerima siapa dirinya yang sebenar?

programme.title: Bawang Puteh Bawang Merah
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Pak Ali mempunyai dua orang isteri iaitu Labu dan Kundor. Hasil dari perkahwinannya yang pertama dan kedua mereka dikurniakan anak bernama Bawang Merah dan Bawang Putih.

programme.title: Lesen Besar
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan yang rindu zaman bujang mereka telah merancang untuk pergi 'road trip' setelah mendapat pelepasan daripada isteri dan teman wanita masing-masing. Tapi nasib tidak menyebelahi mereka di sepanja

programme.title: La La Boy
programme.desc: Filem yang mengisahkan tentang persahabatan, percintaan dan kehidupan dua remaja di Sekolah Buriram Witthayaprasit.

programme.title: Haq
programme.desc: Haq dan Bad yang dianugerahkan kuasa luar biasa mula bersengketa kerana Bad percaya bahawa Haq yang menyebabkan kematian ayahnya. Lakonan Zul Huzainmy dan Adi Putra.

programme.title: Karya 12-Wau Kasih
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang kisah pengorbanan seorang ayah untuk membantu keluarga namun ianya disalah erti oleh anak-anaknya.

programme.title: Lukisan
programme.desc: Kisah Amir, seorang budak kampung yang cuba merungkai misteri di sebalik jeritan Piah, gadis yang tinggal berhampiran rumahnya yang dikatakan gila dan selalu berhalusinasi. Dapatkah rahsia itu dibongkar?

programme.title: Surga Di Bawah Langit
programme.desc: Ayu, Agus dan Laras bergelut setiap hari demi kelangsungan hidup tanpa pernah mengimpikan apa-apa. Apabila dewasa, mereka bertemu semula di tempat yang mereka janjikan.

programme.title: Gadis KOL

programme.desc: Raja bermimpi yang anak perempuannya telah diculik olah lanun, sebelum mangkat baginda memerintah paglima maencari dan membawa anaknya pulang keistana.

programme.title: The Singing Escort

programme.title: Shadow Girl

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: A dying crime lord sends a gang of assassins to steal a special herb that may cure him. However, they become the targets of a couple on a vendetta.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: Police Force

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Nota Silam

programme.title: Puyah & Putat

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love

programme.desc: Each episodes, Michael take viewers through different halal dishes – from inspiration to preparation from western to Chinese to fusion cuisines. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: Super Game Boy The Series (Astro Ceria)
programme.desc: Danial dan kawan-kawannya Ayu, Bob dan Nina kembali beraksi dengan gelagat mereka yang lucu dan menarik. Berjayakah misi mereka di dalam setiap episod? Jom kita saksikannya.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: Dee The Series
programme.desc: Dee bersama adik dan ibunya Amy, memulakan hidup baru di KL apabila Amy mendapat kerja baru di sebuah kolej swasta. Bermulalah satu dunia baru untuk Dee yang penuh dengan muzik, gelak ketawa dan air mata.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.desc: The barn is heating up as Maddie and Kiki serve up a lineup of smoky, savoury, and sweet BBQ favourites! This time, they create their own turkey pastrami, build a spinach salad with bacon and cashews, and turn grilled pineapple into a delicious campfire-inspired treat.

programme.title: Fish, Fire & Fruity Flair
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are turning up the heat with a BBQ feast full of bold flavours and creative combinations! On this episode, they smoke prosciutto-wrapped jalapeño poppers, toss a baby arugula salad with pine nuts and grilled nectarines, and serve whole grilled trout with strawberry salsa.

programme.title: Smoky Prime Rib & Summer Berry Bliss
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are serving up a BBQ feast packed with smoky flavours and creative twists! On this episode, they load up grilled potato skins with lardons and pico de gallo, smoke a tender prime rib with a fresh watercress salad, and finish with a summer berry pudding topped with toasted almonds.

programme.title: Rotisserie, Plums & Sister Fun
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are bringing global flavours to the grill with a fresh lineup of BBQ favourites! On this episode, they toss together an Asian pasta salad with charred green onions, roast lemon chicken on the spit with chili lime aioli, and grill plums served with lime mascarpone.

programme.title: Grilled Bites & Backyard Delights
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are firing up the grill for a colourful mix of fresh flavours and backyard favourites! On this episode, they make a charred corn, red pepper, and arugula salad, grill a shrimp pizza on flatbread, and serve up lamb sliders topped with Fuji apple chutney.

programme.title: Ribs, Roots & Sweet Rewards
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are embracing big BBQ flavours with a feast of smoky meats, fresh sides, and sweet finishes! On this episode, they smoke whole beef ribs with maple butter acorn squash, grill Korean short ribs with celeriac and apple slaw, and create a strawberry mascarpone trifle.

programme.title: Savory Duck & Refreshing Bites
programme.desc: From smoky mains to fresh summer bites, Maddie and Kiki prove the BBQ is about more than just grilling meat! They whip up tuna bruschetta, pair rich balsamic cherry duck with sweet seasonal flavours, and cool things down with a roasted red pepper gazpacho.

programme.title: Tandoori Treats & Tangy Tenderloin
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are mixing bold marinades and fresh summer flavours for another unforgettable BBQ feast! They grill stout-marinated pork tenderloin with a tangy buttermilk potato salad, turn sweet cantaloupe into a smoky side, and spice things up with tandoori cauliflower.

programme.title: Summery Melon & Ribs Two Ways
programme.desc: It’s all about ribs as Maddie and Kiki show two delicious ways to master the BBQ! They make quick dry jerk baby back ribs, slow-cook ribs with a sticky guava glaze, pair them with vibrant Caribbean and beet salads, and cool things off with refreshing melon treats.

programme.title: Lemony Clams & Porterhouse Feast
programme.desc: Surf, turf, and summer desserts share the spotlight as Maddie and Kiki build a BBQ menu full of bold flavours. They grill clams with lemon butter, toss a chicory and chorizo salad, cook a porterhouse steak with chimichurri, and bake a rustic wild berry crisp.

programme.title: Mexico + Norway
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of baked feta with marinated tomatoes and corn chips, a marinated tomato and jicama salad with cilantro lime dressing, carne molida tacos, and a sous-vide crème caramel.

programme.title: Tailgate Feast: Gameday Grub
programme.desc: Game day traditions meet sizzling creativity as familiar favorites hit the griddle. From sliders to smoky wings, these dishes celebrate casual gatherings and the inventive ways home chefs turn everyday ingredients into shareable, crowd-pleasing bites.

programme.title: Cassoulet
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Carrot Cake
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Borscht
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Seafood Boil
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab; a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. Loaded with scotch-bonnet peppers, osso bucco, and demi-glace, this dish delivers a rich and impressive punch to the tastebuds.

programme.title: Have Fun
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make avocado toast and tacos, Liam whips up an easy pantry pasta, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a favorite one pot meal!

programme.title: Sharing Is Caring
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs prep rainbow fruit skewers, Liam whips up his charity-inspired cheeseburger soup, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a popular Trinidadian street food, fried bread and saltfish!

programme.title: Everybody’s A Chef
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make pancakes, Liam whips up craveable chicken coconut curry, Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make Nashville fried chicken sandwiches, and more!

programme.title: You Got It
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs test kitchen hacks with eggs, Liam whips up the beef and broccoli stir fry he made for friends as a kid, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a beautiful pistachio pasta and Caesar salad!

programme.title: Fast Favs
programme.desc: For a quick and tasty meal, chef Spencer Watts cooks up fast favs using scallops and trout, all done in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: Fruit
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts mixes the sweet flavours of fruit with fish as he makes dishes with salmon and scallops.

programme.title: Dairy
programme.desc: Seafood and dairy make the perfect partners. Watch as Chef Spencer Watts creates some dairy-infused dishes using red snapper and scampi.

programme.title: Tart
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts makes tastebuds dance as he creates recipes that combine sour and tart flavours with grouper and clams.

programme.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Veal Piccata
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Scotland, France, USA, Myanmar
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by Scotland, France, the USA, and Myanmar!

programme.title: Versatile Indian Flavours
programme.desc: Host Vijaya Selvaraju makes delectable Indian dishes using versatile Indian spices and flavours.

programme.title: Papaya Salad, Carrot Hog Dogs, Squid, and Tofu
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford unveils four spellbinding dishes! First up, green papaya salad with crispy pork! Next, BBQ carrot hot dogs! Followed by grilled squid steak! Finishing with Korean BBQ tofu!

programme.title: Yellow
programme.desc: Say hello to yellow with chef Pino Di Cerbo as he brightens each dish with glowing, golden-hued produce! Corn on the cob gets a fun presentation as 'ribs', chopped into spears, spiked with harissa spices, and grilled until smoky. Next is a sweet and sour detour with mangoes and lemons in a no-bake cheesecake with a unique popped amaranth crust. Next, aromatic and hearty Kerala-style curry includes all things gold and beautiful: creamy yellow potatoes, sweet yellow peppers, even snappy yellow beans! Finally, stick around for a Thai-inspired noodle salad, where even the noodles are veggies! Strands of mildly sweet spaghetti squash paired with nutty cashews, tender sprouts and a punchy ginger-rice vinaigrette!

programme.title: Hearty Weeknight Multi-Cooker Dishes
programme.desc: Do you know the secret to an uncracked cheesecake? Host Vanessa Gianfrancesco shares her trick to making a perfectly silky-smooth Salted Caramel Cheesecake.

Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Avocados and Apricots
programme.desc: "A" is on the menu and Chef Robert Jewell takes on this meal challenge with apricots and avocados. First up, Robert cooks a spicy roasted quail and drizzles it with some sweet apricot and calvados sauce. Next, is a meal best served cold! Robert slices up sushi-grade tuna and transforms it into a flavourful tartare, brought to life by rich avocado and refreshing lime. On the side, he adds crusty crostini with savoury soy sauce and sesame oil, the perfect complement for this meltin- your-mouth meal. For his final dish, Robert combines apricots and avocados for an unbelievably tasty dish.

programme.title: Dill and Duck
programme.desc: Host Theresa Visintin picks the letter "D" in this challenge and combines two very different ingredients – dill and duck! But that’s no big dill for Theresa. For her first dish, Theresa uses dill seeds and weed to make a hearty, creamy dill pickle soup. She adds chicken broth and potatoes as her base but makes the soup extra smooth with some sour cream. She tops the soup with dill pickles to add a delightful crunch. Next, Theresa takes duck, a classic French ingredient, and gives it a French Canadian twist – duck tourtière. Using the duck fat to fry up some veggies, she adds red wine to her chicken stock and simmers the meat. Then, Theresa fills a pie crust with this delightful duck filling and coats the crust with egg wash before baking it to a golden brown. Finally, Theresa takes on both ingredients to create a delectable dill and duck dish.

programme.desc: It's time to celebrate the art of smoking with wood! You'll drool over Spencer's Cherrywood Smoked Chicken Wings, dry rubbed with his favourite spices and smoked with cherrywood. programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Boo! Did that scare you? If so, then you better steer clear of this super spooky Holiday Eatz Halloween episode with chef-host Kimberly Lallouz! Next, you'd miss a ghostly surprise with her pan seared Black Cod buried in a pile of carrot-chip 'Autumn Leaves' and drizzled with mango sauce made with"... ghost peppers! Her 'Fet Ghede' (Haitian Day of the Dead) inspired beef rib follows"... with a rib bone connected to"... melting tender beef braised in Haiti's signature Epis spice and crunched-up with yummy pumpkin seeds. For a sweet ending, it's a 'Bag of Candy'"... or in this case, homemade profiterole stuffed with mascarpone and all of your favourite candies! See, that wasn't so scary, was it? Mwahahahaha!

programme.title: Picnic

programme.title: Saturday Morning Breakfast

programme.title: Brunch Brawl
programme.desc: Maddy and Kiki put a fresh spin on a beloved brunch staple, with homemade lox and bagels facing off against smoky carrot lox and high-protein bagels, all piled high with creamy spreads and classic toppings for a seriously satisfying spread.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Elevated Eats: Gourmet on the Griddle
programme.desc: Fine dining meets flat-top finesse. Discover how classic ingredients and refined techniques transform into elegant, restaurant-worthy dishes, proving the griddle is a tool for true culinary artistry.

programme.title: The Art of Wood

programme.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Veal Piccata
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography- Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can’t be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera’s clues?

programme.title: New Epidemic
programme.desc: In late August of 1999, an infectious disease specialist in Queens, New York reports that she has two elderly patients with neurological disorders. More cases crop up in the following days, several patients die. Initial tests confirm that New York has been hit by an outbreak of the mosquito-borne illness, St. Louis encephalitis. Nearly a month later, exotic birds begin to die at the Bronx Zoo. Zoo officials discover they have been infected with West Nile, a virus never before diagnosed in the Western Hemisphere. With this new information, epidemiologists studying the cases of St. Louis encephalitis are lead to a different and shocking conclusion, the virus is spreading to humans.

programme.desc: It seemed like a match made in heaven when youth pastor Couty married a preacher's daughter, but when Couty meets his untimely end, a police investigation reveals a web of lies.

programme.title: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis- With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars. Forensic scientists can analyze droplets of blood, hair fiber, or a piece of chewed gum to determine the identity of a victim or killer or to prove innocence.

programme.title: Invisible Threat
programme.desc: In August of 1998, Marilyn Miller is awakened by her son’s frightened cries. She finds him suffering from a dangerously high fever and severe abdominal pains. As doctors work to stabilize him, she begins to feel the sickening symptoms herself. Doctor’s suspect a food poisoning outbreak and direct her to call the Minnesota Department of Health. Within days, the department receives several more phone calls and launches an investigation. Health officials must identify the contagion and track it to its source.

programme.title: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology- Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life. The kinds of insects on bodies, along with their stage of development, can pinpoint time of death and help identify victims.

programme.title: Summer Exposure
programme.desc: On the tiny resort island of Martha’s Vineyard, landscaper, Patrick Ryer, suffers from chills and high fever. Patrick has contracted Tularemia, a rare bacterial disease. Health officials alert residents and tourists who crowd the Vineyard over the summer holiday. Over the next month, ten more people are diagnosed with the disease, including other landscapers and children. Medical investigators from the Center for Disease Control and state officials search for a common link. Tularemia is so infectious that it is on the government’s watch list of biological weapons. Based on the number of people infected, officials quickly rule out terrorism, but none of the cases appear to be related. All they are able to determine is that most of the victims have outdoor occupations such as landscaping and construction. The findings mark the first time landscaping has been named as a risk factor for the disease.

programme.title: Taking the Plunge
programme.desc: After dating for two months, Cynthia and Randy decide to elope, but tragedy strikes when one of them is found dead, leading police to investigate and discover a shocking truth.

programme.title: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting- Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim’s likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: Unlikely Source
programme.desc: A hospital in Walkerton, Ontario is flooded with patients with the same alarming symptoms. All suffer from fever, nausea and gastrointestinal problems. Health officials suspect water contamination, but the Public Utilities Commission (PUC) reports that the water is safe. The next day, 20 more patients are admitted with the same symptoms. Health officials determine E. Coli bacteria is contaminating the drinking water and warn the public. Bottled water is handed out to residents. In order to stop the epidemic, health officials must locate the source. Before the outbreak is stopped, four adults and an infant die from the deadly bacteria.

programme.desc: Llius marries Tony, a music promoter, but their holy union ends gruesomely, and detectives head down a path where sinister truths begin to emerge.

programme.desc: A hospital in Walkerton, Ontario is flooded with patients with the same alarming symptoms. All suffer from fever, nausea and gastrointestinal problems. Health officials suspect water contamination, but the Public Utilities Commission (PUC) reports that the water is safe. The next day, 20 more patients are admitted with the same symptoms. Health officials determine E. Coli bacteria is contaminating the drinking water and warn the public. Bottled water is handed out to residents. In order to stop the epidemic, health officials must locate the source. Before the outbreak is stopped, four adults and an infant die from the deadly bacteria.

programme.title: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person- Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples. In addition to pictures on milk cartons, store windows, and in mass mailings, authorities use nationwide computer databases to help locate missing persons or match them with unidentified bodies. Even so, many of the missing are never seen again.

programme.title: Island Fever
programme.desc: In the summer of 2001, Debby Stoner’s family begins to exhibit severe flu like symptoms. Upon visiting the family, who live in a small village on Maui, doctors discover that others are also suffering from strange symptoms including headaches, fevers and a bizarre red rash. Health officials are concerned they are dealing with a terrifying virus that is spread by mosquitoes. It is an outbreak of Dengue Fever, imported to the island by travelers from Tahiti. The disease has the potential to spread to other islands and eventually the mainland. In a matter of days, more cases are reported in towns nearby. Without a vaccine or cure, the only option for health officials is to track the virus and eradicate the source, wherever it is found.

programme.title: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains- It’s difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence. But what happens when the charred remains are found, unrecognizable, seemingly impossible to identify? Dr. John Verano and Dr. Doug Owsley of the Smithsonian have faced these challenges, identifying the burned remains of two American journalists found in Guatemala seven years after their reported disappearance. It seems as though fire can unveil lies, as well as conceal truths.

programme.title: Runaway Custard
programme.desc: Deedee uses magic to create endless purple custard helping Tiggy and friends solve missing ingredients

programme.title: Mood Music
programme.desc: Mewmew violin sounds awful Deedee encourages him but townsfolk flee mistaking music for screeching cats

programme.title: Energy Foods: Molybdenum, Milk, Eggs, Bananas & Shellfish
programme.desc: Ants gain energy from seeds. Colts grow strong from milk, eggs. Strengthen teeth, monkeys leap with bananas, and flamingos turn pink from shellfish, showing how foods provide strength, health, and color.

programme.title: Power Foods: Corn, Pulses, Lettuce, Red Meat & Carrots
programme.desc: He got a crown but is not a king—its the rooster. The tallest animal is the giraffe. Bears gain strength from pulses, cheetahs run fast because it consumes lot of meat, hares jump because he eats lots of carrots.

programme.title: Healthy Foods: Citrus, Rice, White Fish, Apples, Pears & Yogurt
programme.desc: The good-hearted donkey carries heavy loads, the athletic rabbit runs long distances, cats stay agile from fish, worms eat apples, and milk magic shows fun, strength, and healthy animal habits.

programme.title: Don't Knock It Till You Have Built It
programme.desc: When Valeo breaks a hole from the Zooniverse into Pancake's room, a swarm of splutterbies enter as well, destroying Pancake's house! Put yourself in someone else's place to see how your actions might affect them and never give up in trying to accomplish your goals.

programme.title: Lend A Helping Stare
programme.desc: Odessa gets into a staring contest with a Stareoffolous and needs to ask for help...but refuses to. You can do it, but sometimes you need to think about what help you need to get to the next step and ask for that help.

programme.title: A Star Is Jumped
programme.desc: Odessa learns to leap over stars by starting on low ones,Persistence pays off, especially when you learn from each step along the way, building up to the final goal.

programme.title: Colour Chaos
programme.desc: Mayor decide what colour to paint the town hall as it is so dull and grey. So Deedee offers to help, without magic this time, by getting a town vote as to which colour is liked best. Deedee and Nino go ahead and do just that, asking each and everybody they see in Abra-Dabra and noting their choice of colours. Boris and Sandy are confused so set out to paint and decide, but end up messing up the wall. They seek the help of Deedee, who is all so ready to help. But Nino is scared things will get worse with the powerful magic spell, and with good reason. programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. programme.desc: Mayor de Pfeffel receives a long awaited package containing new roller skates. Excited he explains he could not skate before with his old pair. Now he is ready to learn and join the towns skating craze eager to show his new skills.

programme.title: The Rolling Rice Ball
programme.desc: WI-Go drops one of his rice balls in a rat hole and gets a handful of jewelry in return. Meanwhile, a greedy neighbor next door UGo hears the news.

programme.title: Stone Soup
programme.desc: WI-Go the traveler is starving and has nothing but his brain. He ends up making the most delicious soup in the world using a mysterious stone without using a single penny.

programme.title: Heungboo and Nolboo
programme.desc: Mischievous UGo takes all of his parents' property and kicks his younger brother GoGo out of the house. Meanwhile, a swallow bird brings a gourd seed to the eaves of a kind-hearted GoGo house, and soon, gourds containing gold and silver treasures opens on the roof of the GoGo's house.

programme.title: The Star Talers
programme.desc: In the cold winter, the kindhearted girl, GoGo, meets several people who feel sorry for her on her way home. A fairy queen appears in front of a GoGGo that distributes all her clothes and bread and shakes in the cold.

programme.title: Wake Up and Smell the Bathtub
programme.desc: Maple avoids taking a bath but in the Zooniverse she helps the Zoonicorns restore their unique scents after they are blown away. She learns the importance of cleanliness and caring for herself.

programme.title: I Can't Heeeear You
programme.desc: Pancake finds the Zoonicorns have lost their voices. He must learn to understand visual clues to help them. Through this he discovers new ways of communication and problem solving.

programme.title: The Tickle Tree Talks
programme.desc: Pancake and the Zoonicorns try to cheer up a sad Tickle Tree. They learn that sometimes simply listening and being present is enough to help a friend feel better.

programme.title: Wapiti's Wheely Good Waka
programme.desc: While preparing their waka for summer Darwin and Newts meet Wapiti using a wheelchair. They work together to make the waka accessible and learn about inclusion.

programme.title: KiwiFruit Valley Christmas
programme.desc: A storm ruins Christmas plans but Darwin Newts and Heni work together. They create a simple celebration and learn that friendship and care matter more than perfection.

programme.title: Banzai as a Kite
programme.desc: While flying kites Gummy builds an advanced one that lifts him into the air. With help from Harry gadgets it goes out of control and the group must act quickly to bring him safely back down.

programme.title: Hairy Harry
programme.desc: Harry suffers from dry skin and seeks help but receives a hair product instead. His hair grows wildly causing chaos and fun as the others enjoy it until Harry finds a way to fix the situation.

programme.title: The Return of the Alien
programme.desc: While using a laser Gummy accidentally triggers an alien event and goes on a wild ride. The experience teaches the group important lessons about responsibility and not misusing gadgets.

programme.title: Earth Day
programme.desc: Lets celebrate this wonderful planet we call home. Make sure to remember our 3 Rs.

programme.title: Flour
programme.desc: Ahh something smells so good, what is it, Oh its Hepi and Brikos fresh new ideas, What are they up to now.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E001
programme.desc: Victoria Guanipa, asegura ante Genara que es la dueña y señora de Catarrana. Hilario Guanipa ordena a sus peones derribar la alambrada que delimita su hacienda porque midieron mal los linderos. Yosmir y Eugenia Alcoy del Casal, la hija menor de Fernanda, se conocen casualmente, pero el encuentro es desafortunado para el muchacho. Pablo va a dar un paseo a caballo, pero el animal sale a toda carrera sin que él pueda controlarlo. Victoria le da alcance al caballo donde va Pablo y lo detiene la pareja se simpatiza de inmediato, él se presenta como Pablo Martínez. Pablo advierte a Felipe que nadie debe saber que él es realmente Nicolás Del Casal.

Hilario Guanipa ordena a sus peones derribar la alambrada que delimita su hacienda porque midieron mal los linderos. Yosmir y Eugenia Alcoy del Casal, la hija menor de Fernanda, se conocen casualmente, pero el encuentro es desafortunado para el muchacho. Pablo va a dar un paseo a caballo, pero el animal sale a toda carrera sin que él pueda controlarlo. Victoria le da alcance al caballo donde va Pablo y lo detiene la pareja se simpatiza de inmediato, él se presenta como Pablo Martínez. Pablo advierte a Felipe que nadie debe saber que él es realmente Nicolás Del Casal.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E002
programme.desc: Victoria que está desnuda explica a Pablo (Nicolás) por qué se quedó sin ropa; el joven le da su camisa para que pueda salir del río. Hilario aprovecha cualquier oportunidad para galantear a Florencia. Por órdenes de Hilario, Zambrano a compaña a Pablo y Felipe en la cacería, pues debe vigilarlos. Victoria reta a Pablo a demostrar su puntería; él quiere como premio un beso de ella. Rosendo asegura a Florencia que a Hilario Guanipa a veces es mejor tenerlo lejos.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E99
programme.desc: Fernando amenaza a Jeli con quitarle al niño, pero Leandro le advierte que él es su padre. Fausto espera a su hijo Gregorio, lo golpea, lo bota de la casa y decide quitarle todas sus pertenencias y beneficios. Ezequiel opta por encerrar a Julia; Gregorio viene a llevarse a su esposa, los encuentra Celso, enfurecido y drogado, y los ataca hiriendo a la joven.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E118
programme.desc: Omar y su Jefe exigen hacer la reconstrucción de los hechos - Patricia habla con Lorena y le pide que le dé una nueva oportunidad a Alberto, pues sabe que ellos aún se aman - Claudio narra la supuesta forma en que sucedieron las cosas, el día de la muerte de Paco; pero Norma no aguanta más tanta falsedad e interrumpe la reconstrucción gritando que todo lo que Claudio dijo es una gran mentira.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E119
programme.desc: María Lourdes comparece ante el Juez Echeverri y se entrega por el delito de corrupción y aceptar sobornos de Gertrudis; entrega una carpeta con documentos que prueban lo que dice para hundir a la señora Corona con ella - Gertrudis se burla de las acusaciones de Alberto y niega, una vez más, ser una asesina. Alberto se va a la biblioteca, no puede vivir sabiendo lo que su madre hizo y no es capaz de aceptar. Se escucha un disparo y todo parece indicar que Alberto se suicidó. Lorena, enardecida, culpa a Gertrudis de lo sucedido y el Jefe corrobora la muerte de su hijo. Gertrudis cae de rodillas, destrozada, gritando como fiera herida.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E52
programme.desc: Clara Inés conversa por teléfono con Cirilo. Sin querer Raúl escucha cuando ella menciona que su hermana Bernice intentó suicidarse.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E53
programme.desc: Acudiendo al llamado de Israel, Clara Inés y Raúl se tensan al desconocer de qué verdad el hombre les quiere hablar.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E003
programme.desc: Hilario advierte a Victoria que no confía en Pablo porque presiente que el joven oculta algo. Ante una indiscreción de Felipe; a Pablo no le queda más remedio que revelarle a Hansen que él es Nicolás Del Casal. Nicolás está decidido a vengarse de Hilario Guanipa por haber matado a su padre. Victoria lee una nota que le dejara Pablo (Nicolás) asegurándole que volverán a verse y pidiéndole que lo espere.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E100
programme.desc: Celso desquiciado veja y se burla de Fausto, éste dispara al pecho del amante que cae al instante. Fausto va hacia su oficina, diciendo a todos que no ha pasado nada. Camila, en el lugar de los hechos, trata de convencer a Patricia que huya pues todo indica que ella es la asesina de Celso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E101
programme.desc: Patricia, llora, negando haber matado a Celso. Fausto manipula a sus hijos para convencerlos de que su madre es la asesina y debe entregarse. Camila declara muy elocuente su versión de los hechos, y luego cuenta a Ezequiel que mintió para hacer pagar a Patricia por un delito que no cometió, tal cual se lo hicieron a su madre.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E030 - Episode 30
programme.desc: María Begoña sin piedad le pregunta a su gemela si sigue enamorada de Carlos Fernando. Mariana desgarrada le suplica a su madre que le cuente toda la verdad a su padre. Abigail está desconsolada con el desprecio de Carlos Alfredo.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E031 - Episode 31
programme.desc: María Begoña amenaza de muerte a Lucía. Bárbara antes de irse del país hace su último intento por conseguir el perdón de Abigail. Bertha sigue con actitud despectiva hacia Rosalba. Abigail le dice a Carlos Alfredo que su hijo vive.

programme.desc: Alberto llega al parque donde está Lorena con Norma e Ignacio. Alberto, arrodillado ante ella, le propone matrimonio a Lorena con un anillo en sus manos. Ella acepta feliz. "El que perdona la ofensa, cultiva el amor…" Fin.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E18 - The Queen Mother An Affectionate Tribute
programme.desc: The Queen Mother, who lived as long as the century itself, was a beloved figure in British life. She was a symbol of bravery during the Second World War and a timeless icon of steadiness, winning a deep affection from people that was only matched by the Queen herself.

programme.desc: The Most Haunted team is in for a spooky surprise with a poltergeist at Halsham House, close to Beverley in East Riding of Yorkshire. Things get even eerier when they find something chilling in the attic.

programme.desc: Radio host Glen Hunt, who's usually a sceptic, starts to question his beliefs after joining the Most Haunted crew at Oak House, a 16th-century farmhouse with timber frames in West Bromwich.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S19:E07 - Middleton Hall, Warwickshire
programme.desc: Yvette Fielding and the Most Haunted crew head to Middleton Hall in North Warwickshire. The place is famous for a visit by Queen Elizabeth I and is known for sightings of a spooky Grey Lady.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S04:E05 - Borwick Hall Part 2

programme.desc: Karl investigates the outbuildings of this large estate, where many people have witnessed strange occurrences, some of which he is about to witness firsthand.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones
programme.desc: The Real Story takes us inside a simple royal love tale. It offers a glimpse behind the scenes of how a Prince ended up falling for a girl from a regular middle-class family.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E25 - Kate The Making Of A Modern Queen
programme.desc: A look at the Duchess of Cambridge's journey from being an everyday young woman to becoming a future queen, and what her evolution signifies for the royal family.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E01 - Riggins Gold
programme.desc: Today on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are on the mighty Salmon River, doing some underwater metal detecting, looking for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E02 - Blue Bucket Oregon Trail
programme.desc: Today on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are on the Oregon trail, hunting for the legendary Blue Bucket Mine.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E67 - Ocean Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A team of scientists embarks on a quest to explore the mesopelagic zone or ocean twilight zone which sits beneath the surface layer of the ocean and stretches around the world. This mysterious region just might hold the key to climate change and the planet’s future.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E01 - The Mission
programme.desc: The United States and China are considering launching manned missions to Mars -- in 25 years. But Netherlands-based Mars One has a bold plan to land humans on Mars in 2027. Is the mission fueled by wishful thinking and unproven science -- or will private exploration get us there?

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E03 - The Journey
programme.desc: The trek from earth to Mars is fraught with difficulties, from surviving radiation en route to landing in a space craft not yet designed. Mars One founder Bas Lansdorp attends the Mars Society Convention in Washington, DC, to debate the risks and rewards with scientists from around the world.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E04 - Surviving on Mars
programme.desc: From a greenhouse in Holland to a desert landscape in Iceland, scientists are using the earth to tests ways to keep a Mars settlement alive and well. It's the ultimate survival challenge, requiring major innovations to find water, grow food and clean the air.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E05 - Why One Way
programme.desc: Mars One plans one-way missions to Mars; the goal is not simply to explore, but to colonize the red planet. A one-way trip saves billions and eliminates the risk of a return voyage. But can the crew survive in such utter isolation? Some candidates for the mission reflect on this challenge.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: The EXO Mars and Curiosity continue their scientific discoveries as we prepare The New missions both robotic and manned to the Red planet Mars.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E05 - Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: As the latest successes and failures come and go Mars continues to give up her secrets. Invisible clouds are revealed with ultraviolet light and the search for the source of methane continues with ExoMars. As we prepare to land humans on the red planet, getting there is one thing; staying long term is another, can we really conquor this planet?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E06 - Emissaries
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space. We humans cannot yet travel that sort of distance, however w e can and do send our robots and probes in our place; and the results are astounding.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E07 - Danger Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15,000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E83 - The Great Seaweed Invasion
programme.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean!

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E60 - Decoding Megalodon
programme.desc: By examining countless Megalodon teeth from around the world, scientists have concluded that "meg" was able to achieve its gargantuan proportions by starting its carnivorous diet early -- in the womb.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E56 - Mars Perseverance: The Hunt Begins
programme.desc: Watch as the Mars Perseverance Rover makes its historic landing on the Red Planet. We take you inside the harrowing February 18, 2021 landing, the science mission, and cutting-edge technology, including the first-ever Martian helicopter.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E01 - Opportunity A Life On Mars

programme.desc: Natural hazards remain a constant challenge for over 400 million people who live in low lying communities built along major mega delta regions in coastal zones. Events like typhoons and tsunamis threaten their very survival.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E03 - Volcanic Field Lab
programme.desc: Many people now know that climate change is real, that they see the data or they see the observations for themselves. What's needed now is a sense of urgency. We have within the next decade exceedingly important decisions to make.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E04 - Food Security
programme.desc: Rice, it's a staple food for many in Asia. It provides 1/3 of the energy in the average Asian diet and is the income source for more than 500 million people. programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E58 - The West Is Burning
programme.desc: How did the western United States become a hotspot for unwieldy and devastating forest fires? Learn how the history of forest management and loss of public trust, coupled with climate change, have led to the conditions driving mega-fire nearly year-round.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E02 - Hammerhead Shark
programme.desc: Travel to the Bahamas as Andy Casagrande attempts to place a fin camera on the elusive hammerhead shark… what could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E03 - Tiger Shark
programme.desc: Ever wondered how a tiger shark hunts and feeds on its prey? Wildlife filmmaker Andy Casagrande travels off the coast of North Carolina to document never before seen behavior of one of the most misunderstood sharks in the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E51 - Return of the Wolves

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E00 - Reefs Of Hope Extended Version
programme.desc: With new state-of-the-art tools and technologies that include curious underwater vehicles and hydrodynamic modeling, scientists have hope of better understanding the threats to coral communities while finding the source to restock reefs worldwide.

programme.desc: So many words describe the many ways that birds fly – pelicans and kestrels soar but owls fly silently. Parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E09 - Disguised

programme.desc: Terry and Larry tackle the epic Lethal Weapon series testing 4 different scenes.
